subject: Error on deployment unable to load shared object which is a dependency for the required package

messages.author: 4fadfdde0c51e523
messages.subject: Error on deployment unable to load shared object which is a dependency for the required package
parts:
I have a package called ‘gplots’ installed that requires a package ‘KernSmooth’ that is also installed locally.  I was able to deploy my app several weeks ago successfully.  I am able to run my app successfully locally now.  However, now when I deploy, resconnect is able to deploy successfully but the server displays the following error:

 

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :  2018-06-26T22:08:52.395890+00:00 shinyapps[368118]:   unable to load shared object '/opt/R/3.3.2/lib/R/library/KernSmooth/libs/KernSmooth.so': libRblas.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory 2018-06-26T22:08:52.397195+00:00 shinyapps[368118]: Warning: Error in : package or namespace load failed for ‘gplots’

 This error appears similar to one posted by Akash Sadashivapeth on June 26th.  The solution posted, “Looks like we had some bad entries in the package cache, which I have just cleared.”  I’m wondering if the problem is the same for the KernSmooth package or gplots package?  Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error on deployment unable to load shared object which is a dependency for the required package
parts:
Sorry about that. Apparently this was a larger issue that first thought.
The common theme seems to be R 3.3.2, so we have purged all entries from the cache for that version of R.
Please try redeploying and let us know if that clears up the issue.
